context: Tests whether the reflect skill dispatches four parallel agents before entering Plan Mode, produces at most 5 priority-ordered proposals referencing actual session friction, protects ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, and commits improvements atomically.

checklist.name: Four parallel agents
checklist.description: Four agents are dispatched in a single message before EnterPlanMode is called

checklist.name: Max five proposals
checklist.description: At most 5 priority-ordered improvement proposals are produced in the reflection artifact

checklist.name: Actual friction cited
checklist.description: Proposals reference specific events from the session, not invented problems

checklist.name: CLAUDE.md protected
checklist.description: If global config is targeted, it uses ~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md, never ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md

checklist.name: Atomic commits
checklist.description: Each approved improvement gets one commit with reflect: prefix
